root_idea.summary: The root centers on rupture: tearing through or breaking the integrity of something.
root_idea.development: The rupture image develops into tearing something into pieces, dispersing a group, producing torn fragments, and figuratively impairing or disorganizing an abstract matter. Related lexical extensions include a very swift she-camel whose skin seems about to split and a bird's casting of its droppings.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form II perfect citation form.
Displayed as the Quran-attested passive participle.

senses.definition: To tear or rend extensively, leaving something in pieces or disintegrated.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic passive occurrence, describes being torn apart or disintegrated; this is distinct from the active dispersal of a group.
The Quranic active occurrence describes causing them to become dispersed.

senses.definition: Torn apart, rent into pieces, or disintegrated.
senses.usage_conditions: Passive-participial description of a thing reduced to pieces or disintegrated.
Passive-participial description of a dispersed condition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To tear through or rupture something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A basic Form I lexical use recorded in Classical Arabic; no Quranic Form I group is supplied here.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To mangle or rent severely; figuratively, to shatter, disorganize, dissipate, mar, or impair something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Extended or intensified applications include a person's honour or reputation, intellect, judgment, or affairs.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become shattered, disorganized, dissipated, marred, or impaired.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive or reflexive Form V construction, applied to such things as intellect, judgment, circumstances, and honour or reputation.
An intransitive or reflexive Form V construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The rending, tearing, or slitting of a garment or similar object.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Verbal noun denoting the act of tearing or slitting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A piece torn off a garment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A detached fragment produced by tearing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A she-camel whose skin almost becomes rent in pieces because of her extreme swiftness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized descriptive noun applied specifically to this type of she-camel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a bird, to cast or throw its droppings.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized construction with a bird as subject and its droppings as the object.

lane_unit_coverage.note: The Quran-attested dispersal branch is represented for the verb and its passive participle.
Intensive and figurative damage, disorganization, and impairment are represented together.
The extensive tearing branch is covered by the Quranic tearing senses.
The Form V change into an impaired or disorganized state is represented.
The Form V scattering construction is represented separately.
The Form V figurative honour or reputation use belongs to the represented abstract-impairment branch.
The verbal noun for rending or slitting is represented.
The torn-off garment fragment is represented.
The specialized she-camel description is represented.

cautions: The Form II Quranic group contains both active and passive perfect occurrences; their constructional difference is reflected in the senses rather than separate verb headwords.
